title: Canonical parity circuit size bound
statement: For all natural numbers $n$ and $q$, the size of the canonical parity depth circuit built with block side $\max(1,\lceil n^{1/(q+2)}\rceil)$ is at most $(q+2)(n^{1/(q+2)}+1)^{q+1}2^{n^{1/(q+2)}+1}$.
